name: Junk and temporary files
source: Files and folders that operating systems, editors and programming tools create on their own and that carry no research content.

rules.explanation: macOS keeps the view settings of a folder in this hidden file. It is of no use to anyone else; delete it.
macOS stores a custom folder icon in this hidden file. Delete it.
macOS search index of a drive. Delete this folder.
macOS log of file changes on a drive. Delete this folder.
macOS folder for temporary items. Delete it.
The macOS trash of a drive. Delete this folder.
macOS makes this extra copy of a file's hidden attributes (an AppleDouble file) when files are copied or zipped on a Mac. Delete it.
macOS adds this folder when files are zipped on a Mac; it only holds copies of file attributes. Delete it, and zip the package again with a tool that leaves it out.
Windows keeps picture thumbnails of a folder in this hidden file. Delete it.
Windows keeps picture thumbnails of a folder in this hidden file. Delete it.
Windows keeps the display settings of a folder in this hidden file. Delete it.
The Windows recycle bin of a drive. Delete this folder.
Microsoft Office makes this lock file while a document is open and leaves it behind when it closes badly. Delete it.
LibreOffice makes this lock file while a document is open and leaves it behind when it closes badly. Delete it.
A backup copy that an editor made automatically (the name ends in ~). Delete it.
A backup copy of another file (.bak). Delete it, or give the file you want to keep a descriptive name.
A swap file that the editor Vim leaves behind while a file is open. Delete it.
A swap file that the editor Vim leaves behind while a file is open. Delete it.
A temporary file that a program forgot to remove (.tmp). Delete it.
A temporary file that a program forgot to remove (.temp). Delete it.
The list of commands typed in an R session. It can hold file paths and passwords, and nobody needs it. Delete it.
RStudio keeps the state of your session in this folder. Delete it.
Python stores compiled copies of scripts in this folder. They are recreated when the code runs. Delete it.
A compiled copy of a Python script. It is recreated when the code runs. Delete it.
Jupyter keeps autosaved copies of notebooks in this folder. Delete it.
The Linux trash of a drive. Delete this folder.
The Git history of the project. It can hold earlier versions of files, including data or passwords that were deleted later. Keep it only if you want to share the history; otherwise remove it.
The Subversion history of the project. It can hold earlier versions of files. Keep it only if you want to share the history; otherwise remove it.
The Mercurial history of the project. It can hold earlier versions of files. Keep it only if you want to share the history; otherwise remove it.
Settings of a JetBrains editor (PyCharm, IntelliJ and others). They can hold paths on your own computer. Remove the folder unless you want to share it.
Settings of the Visual Studio Code editor. They can hold paths on your own computer. Remove the folder unless you want to share it.
